name: organic-discovery-skill
title_zh: 给 AI 编码助手做技术 SEO 与内容分发审计
tagline_zh: 搜不到、不收录、AI 不引用？一次审计覆盖索引、GEO、YMYL 证据与 App Store 可见性。
tagline_en: Not indexed? Invisible to AI? One audit covers indexing, GEO, YMYL evidence, App Store discovery, and post-deploy.
desc_en: Technical SEO, assistant visibility, content strategy, earned distribution planning, and evidence governance for AI coding agents. Activate for SEO audits, Search Console, indexing, AI/assistant visibility, organic content and distribution planning, GEO, YMYL evidence, App Store discovery, structured data, international SEO, and post-deploy checks. The legacy name seo-skill and /seo command remain
why_zh: 不是泛泛的 SEO 清单，而是把「证据治理」当一等公民：每个建议都绑定可验证的 Search Cons。
why_en: Treats evidence governance as a first-class citizen: every recommendation ties to verifiable Search Console data and structured.
limit_zh: 只认 Google Search Console 与标准结构化数据；不接 Bing/Yandex 后台。
limit_en: Only Google Search Console and standard structured data; no Bing/Yandex. YMYL needs your own credentials—else hints only. Output stops at audit.
